_comment: Two independent config shapes in one file for reference — a real Claude Code
or VS Code config takes only its own top-level key (mcpServers / servers), not both.
Replace <ABS-PATH-TO-REPO> with the absolute path to this aix-format checkout.
`uv run --with mcp --with pyyaml server.py` is the exact invocation smoke_test.py
and client_harness.py use; --federation defaults to experiments/fixtures/federation.aix.yaml
if omitted, so it can be dropped for the default fixture federation.

_claude_code._comment: `claude mcp add aix-federation -- uv run --with mcp --with pyyaml <ABS-PATH-TO-REPO>/experiments/e4-mcp/server.py --federation <ABS-PATH-TO-REPO>/experiments/fixtures/federation.aix.yaml` writes this into .claude.json / .mcp.json.

_vscode_dot_vscode_mcp_json._comment: Save as .vscode/mcp.json in a workspace opened at the repo root; VS Code's MCP support reads relative paths against the workspace, so ${workspaceFolder} substitutes for <ABS-PATH-TO-REPO>. Resources (aix://<namespace>/<id>) are what the VS Code side-test (E4 measure 3) exercises manually.
